name: Payment auto-applied to an invoice appears in that invoice's Payments list and shows the invoice number

Deleting an earlier stock adjustment gives back its quantity (stock = before − 1), or deletion is refused

Invoice CSV export writes the discount column as money (e.g. 10.00), like the other amounts

Safety copy made before a restore contains the most recent changes (so nothing is lost)
